# Aegix

> FMEA software from XWARE. Aegix combines a central engineering model with AI
> agents to carry Design and Process FMEA (DFMEA and PFMEA) from specification
> through to risk analysis and improvement actions, following the AIAG-VDA
> seven-step method with Action Priority rating. Engineers review and validate
> every AI-generated step.

Aegix is a product of XWARE, an engineering consultancy for safety-critical
systems founded in 2021, with offices in Brussels (Belgium) and Iași (Romania).
Development was funded by a grant from Innoviris, the Brussels research and
innovation agency. XWARE is a partner of hub.brussels.

## What Aegix does

- Builds the FMEA from engineering data that already exists: requirements,
  specifications, architecture documents, previous FMEAs and ALM systems.
- Supports Design FMEA and Process FMEA, with configurable templates.
- Follows AIAG-VDA: structure analysis, function analysis, failure analysis,
  risk analysis with Action Priority, and optimisation with revised ratings.
- Keeps the failure chain linked, so a failure mode still points back to the
  requirement it threatens and forward to the verification that covers it.
- Integrates with Polarion for requirements traceability.
- AI generates; engineers review, challenge and approve. Nothing is accepted
  without human validation.
